notes: Corrected the head of δυσβάστακτα → *grievous to be borne* from *grievous* to *borne*: rule 66 heads a compound rendered by two glossing English words on the verbal core, and rule 104's εὐπειθής → *easy to be entreated* is the same shape. Edges and all other units unchanged.
The projection carries r01 with δυσβάστακτα, which the ASV translates; the ASV's own note records the shorter reading, but the English is aligned to the token present (rule 12).

*men's* treated as a genitive possessor displacing the outer article's determiner under rule 20's *'s* clause, with the inner article unrepresented for want of a determiner on the possessor (rule 57).
